summary: Frontend-only testing of /web2.html static premium page. All requested acceptance checks PASSED, including the P0 no-auto-switch bug. Auto-switch count was 0 over ~20s of polling across fresh load, idle wait, scroll, and additional idle wait without any clicks.

P0_auto_switch.notes: Polled body.classList every 500ms for ~20s (10s idle + scroll into selector + another 10s idle). body.acuerdos never became true; [data-testid=seg-judiciales] kept class 'on'; [data-testid=seg-acuerdos] never gained 'on'.

manual_switch.notes: Click seg-acuerdos -> body.acuerdos=true, VIP module visible, grid-acu visible. Click seg-judiciales -> body.acuerdos=false, VIP module hidden.

frozen_geometry.notes: gap between mode-switch bottom and first visible .deal top identical in both modes (0px diff, target <=2).

entry_cards.backgrounds: all rgb(255,255,255), backgroundImage none (no gradient on Inversor)

critical_code_review_comments: web2.html is a single 1371-line static file; the P0 fix (removing auto-demo IntersectionObserver, forcing setMode(false) at line 1367) is correctly implemented. Only the reveal-animation IntersectionObserver remains (line 1346) and does NOT touch mode/body class.
No accessibility labels on the segmented mode buttons (aria-pressed would help); non-blocking.
